summary:
The bad() entry point reads the "name" request parameter and concatenates it directly into an HTML img src attribute, enabling reflected XSS (CWE-83). The fix HTML-encodes the attribute-significant characters (ampersand, less-than, greater-than, double-quote, single-quote) in the user-supplied value before writing it into the attribute. Legitimate names still render inside the img src attribute, so the feature is preserved; only characters that could break out of the attribute context are escaped.</parameter>
